text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking around the
academy...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Prettiest Dream. Tea like you've never
tasted
before..." I wonder what it's like.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No way I could go to a place like that
just to try
it, though...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: N-no, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That day after class...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Should I check out the cafe? No, it's
too cute, I
can't—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whoa! You again?!
choice_data_list_en: If you want to go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: D-did you hear me just now?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I want to go. I was just a
little curious!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's not like I really want to go. I
was just a
little curious...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I read in a magazine that it has good
tea—that's
all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I read in a magazine that it has good
tea—that's
all!
choice_data_list_en: Then let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Wait a mi—
choice_data_list_en: Then let's go check it out!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: W-we really came...

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! ♪ What will you be having
today,
lovelies?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: "L-lovelies"?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-I'll have the, uh... Prettiest Dream.

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, you have exquisite taste, honey. ♪
That
adorable tea is exclusive to our
cafe!

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text: Okay! ♪ Coming right up, darlings!
choice_data_list_en: Then I'll go with that too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Urgh... I really don't fit in here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It is! I don't belong in the same sentence
as words
like "cute" or "darling."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't have to say things just to
be nice! I
know better than anyone that I
don't belong here.

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Here are your Prettiest Dreams,
sweethearts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Here are your Prettiest Dreams,
sweethearts! ♪

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Now, repeat after me so we can cast a
spell over
your tea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Let's elevate your Prettiest Dreams!
Make a heart
with your hands, and...

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Lovely, lovely beam! ♪ Make this tea
taste like a
dream! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! That was so adorable! ♪
Now it's
your turn!

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! That was so adorable! ♪
Now it's
your turn!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
N-no way! I'm not cut out for this kind
of—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! I know this is why we came all this
way, but
still...

ドーベルなりの言葉でいいんじゃない？

Wouldn't it be fine in your own words, Dober?

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text: Let's go! You can do it, dearie! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
O-okay, fine, I'll do it! But cover your
ears,
Trainer! And close your eyes too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Inhale...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Lovely, lovely beam... ♪ Make this tea
taste like a
dream... ♪

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Oh, how curious! ♪ Thanks to your
magic, this tea
has become even more
delicious, honey! ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't even tell what this tastes
like
anymore...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
My one saving grace is that you didn't
hear me
say that spell...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...You didn't hear me say that, right?
You heard
nothing, right?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though I had covered my ears, I
was still
able to hear her chant... but I
decide to keep that
to myself.

Even though I had covered my ears, I

able to hear her chant... but I
decide to keep that

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: My own words?

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's a great idea. ♪ As long as you
pour
your feelings into your spell, I'm
sure the tea will
become more delicious,
sweetie!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: H-here I go, then...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: B-become tastier... Please!

text_block_list.name: Cute Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ♪ Your original spell was so
adorable, love!
And look, the tea's
absolutely delighted!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I-it wasn't adorable at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: As if that's how it works...

text_block_list.text: ...Oh, it is delicious... Did it really work?

text_block_list.text:
She likes the tea so much, she decides
to buy
some leaves... but she won't tell
me if she casts a
spell over the tea at
home.
